# Neopolis Infra

> Neopolis Infra (Neopolis Infra Developers) is a specialist landlord-share real-estate desk in West Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We sell the landowner's allocated flats (the "landlord share") direct to buyers, typically 8-14% below comparable resale, title-verified, with no broker chain.

## What we do
We deliver landlord-share flats direct to buyers across West Hyderabad. A landlord share is the set of flats a landowner receives from a builder under a joint development agreement. We connect buyers to those specific units, verify the title, and handle the sale without a broker chain.

## How landlord share works & why it's cheaper
In a joint development, the landowner gives land and receives an allocated number of finished flats in return (the landlord share). Landowners often want to liquidate these units efficiently rather than market them flat by flat. Buying this share direct removes the broker layers and resale markup, so prices typically land 8-14% below comparable resale for an equivalent, title-clear flat. These are ordinary flats with full ownership rights and standard registration; the only difference is the source.

## Corridors we cover
- Kokapet: premium West Hyderabad corridor on the financial-district edge; our primary geo anchor (approx 17.404, 78.334).
- Narsingi: established residential and connectivity hub adjacent to the ORR.
- Neopolis: the planned Kokapet "Neopolis" layout, a high-demand new-build zone.
- Manchirevula: lake-view residential pocket near Narsingi and the ORR.
- Tellapur: large-format gated-community and township corridor near the IT belt.
- Kollur: emerging value corridor on the western growth axis.

## Pricing logic
Landlord-share flats are priced typically 8-14% below comparable resale for an equivalent unit in the same project or micro-market. The saving comes from buying direct on the landlord's share with no broker chain and no resale markup. Flats are title-verified before listing and are loan-eligible like any normal apartment. Typical ticket sizes range from about ₹0.9 Cr to ₹3.5 Cr.

## How to buy
1. Message us on WhatsApp or call with your budget, preferred corridor, and flat size.
2. We share matching landlord-share units, title documents, pricing, and walkthroughs (remote-friendly for NRI buyers).
3. We coordinate verification, home-loan documentation, and registration. No buyer brokerage.

## FAQ
- What is a landlord share? The flats a landowner receives from a builder under a joint-development agreement, sold direct to you — same tower and spec as developer units.
- Is a landlord-share flat legally different? No. It is an ordinary, fully owned, registrable flat. Same rights and documentation as any other unit.
- Why is it cheaper? No marketing load and no broker chain, so it typically lands 8-14% below comparable resale.
- Is the title clean? Yes. Every unit is title-verified before listing; your own advocate can review the same documents.
- Can I get a home loan? Yes. Landlord-share flats are loan-eligible like any normal apartment, subject to lender approval.
- Do buyers pay brokerage? No. We work direct on the landlord's share, so there is no broker chain and no buyer brokerage.
- Can NRIs buy remotely? Yes. We handle the full process over WhatsApp and phone, including documentation and registration via Power of Attorney where needed.
